understand.concept: Floating-point types represent approximate real numbers. float, double and long double offer different precision and range, but exact characteristics are implementation-dependent. Decimal values may not be represented exactly in binary.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct data declarations and type choices make C++ programs easier to understand, safer and more portable.
understand.explain: Use double for most general floating-point calculations. Avoid exact equality checks for computed decimal values; choose tolerances based on the problem's scale.
